objective: Give deployment-aligned search-policy distillation one bounded, converged attempt before deciding whether new RL/self-play data are required.

decision.candidate_selection: Compare selected checkpoints on the common validation matrix. Prefer a Pareto-dominant checkpoint; if none dominates, use the fixed priority of hybrid, action, visits provided it is not materially worse (>0.01 KL or >1 percentage point action agreement) on either teacher target.
decision.next_game_gate: At most one selected checkpoint receives a fresh 100-game counterbalanced screen against R1.
decision.screen_continue_threshold: Continue only if candidate wins at least 55 of 100 games.
decision.screen_stop_threshold: Stop this distillation round below 55 of 100 games.
decision.full_gate: If the screen continues, add 400 fresh games and require both game-level and counterbalanced-unit 95% lower confidence bounds above 0.50.
decision.ladder: No public ladder deployment before the full gate passes.
